name: David Burton
tagline: Brooklyn guy who likes to pretend he's a photographer.
meta_description: Home base for David Burton: 35mm concert, travel and New York photography, the Worn on Tour portrait project, the If You Get Confused newsletter, and five-star reviews of burritos.
hero_words: walks up to strangers in band tees
hero_intro: I picked up a film camera at my parents' place during the pandemic and have slowly used it more and more. I've always wanted to get really good at taking pictures. That's still a work in progress. In the meantime this is where the pictures live, along with everything else I can't stop talking about.

worn_on_tour.title: Worn on Tour
worn_on_tour.quote: It can be a tad uncomfortable to walk up to random people and ask to take a picture of them. So far it's been worth the awkwardness.
worn_on_tour.body: A portrait project that combines the two hobbies: music and photography. Portraits, on film, of people around New York City wearing cool band merchandise. Neil Young tank tops, Smiths tees, Dead shirts that have clearly been to a lot of shows.

reviews_intro: Borrowed from John Green's The Anthropocene Reviewed, and from a year-end newsletter where I rated the year on a five-star scale. Not self-help. Just a bit of fun.

reviews.note: Goose six times, Parcels, Luke Bryan, a bluegrass band at Sunny's in Red Hook, and rooms as small as Pete's Candy Store. The full concert experience.
Officially my favorite food. Rating every new spot across four boroughs. Scrolling Reddit and Google Maps for the next one is one of my most relaxing activities.
Thirty-six chances per roll, and you don't find out for two weeks. Somehow that's the appeal.
Reformed IPA snob with 370+ Untappd check-ins. Turns out the point was always sharing a round with people.
Like a car fresh off a tune-up. Gotta look good to feel good.
Concerts alone, new jobs, asking strangers for a portrait. It never really goes away. You just stop letting it decide.
If the main thing I don't like about my job is that I feel like I don't deserve it, I'm probably in the right room.
Best movie I watched last year. They absolutely nailed the ending.

newsletter.title: If You Get Confused
newsletter.subtitle: A newsletter meant to be listened to.
newsletter.origin: Named for the Grateful Dead lyric: "If you get confused, listen to the music play." It's a method that has always worked for me.

bucket_list_intro: Venues worth traveling for. Underrated places, something funky about the room, music I actually like, and logistics that won't ruin it for an anxious person.

bucket_list.note: There are Red Rocks frames in the Travel roll, so we're counting it.
Labor Dave Weekend. As a fellow Dave with a Labor Day birthday, this is destiny.
A 600-cap barn in rural Iowa. What other reason would I have to go to Iowa?
A 1950s German cargo ship you see a show inside of.
An 1880 church. The Stones played it in '95.
Tiny Fishtown dive, shows upstairs. If I'm going to Philly, I'm going here.
Was in town. It was Christian-rock weekend. Missed Phish by three weeks.
